summary: The daily answers check no longer counts claims that a record repair replaced. A member that admitted or wrote such a claim before the repair arrived keeps its row, while one that received the repair first never admits it, so members differed in claim counts with every answer the same (see #4282)

replay.detail: No claim is written or read differently; only the check's summary leaves those claims out.

schema.detail: No schema change; the summary reads the existing projection_digest_repaired_claims table.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: A member on an older build still counts those claims, so a pair with one keeps reporting the difference until both run this build.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade.
